about_pullquote: We started this to beat the cowboys who overcharge and disappear.
about_para_1: Alex Batheg Plumbing and Heating has been serving Oldham homes and businesses for over 15 years. We built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing the job right first time, and charging fair prices — no hidden fees, no pressure sales. Every engineer carries the parts needed for most repairs, so your heating or water is back on the same day.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat their home with respect and explain what's wrong before we start work. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, and we stand behind every job with a guarantee. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler swap, we're the plumber Oldham trusts.
reviews_heading: What Oldham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Heating went out on a Sunday evening in freezing weather. Alex came out within 45 minutes, diagnosed a faulty valve, and had us warm again by nine o'clock. Charged a fair price with no drama. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had him install a new boiler last year after the old one died. Really professional job, explained everything, and the new one has cut our heating bills noticeably. Still under guarantee, so that's peace of mind. Recommended him to three neighbours already.
reviews.author: Linda B.

reviews.text: Radiator started leaking, called Alex on a Tuesday morning, he was here by noon, fixed it, no mess left behind. That's the kind of service you dream about. Will definitely call him first if anything goes wrong again.
reviews.author: David H.
